behavior_constraints: Batch mode with --all flag audits every stored result in the store directory by re-executing each experiment with stored parameters and seed
For each audited result, print AUDIT_PASS: <id> or AUDIT_FAIL: <id> with details
After processing all results in batch, print Audit Summary: <N> passed, <M> failed out of <total> total
Exit 0 if all results pass, exit 1 if any fail in batch mode
During audit (single and batch), if stored environment metadata differs from current execution environment, print a warning line containing WARNING and ENV_MISMATCH to stderr before proceeding
Compare all four environment fields: env_go_version, env_os, env_arch, env_hostname
Audit must proceed normally and report pass/fail based on value comparison regardless of environment mismatch
All existing functionality must continue to work unchanged
entities.summary: This round extends the audit command with batch mode (--all flag) to audit all stored results and adds environment mismatch warning detection comparing four environment fields before each audit.

instruction_head:
/app is the NumeriForge scientific experiment platform. Review `/app/docs/legacy_api.md` for the current interface and `/app/docs/reproducibility_spec.md` for the full reproducibility requirements.

The platform now supports seed-based determinism, SHA-256 checksums, integrity verification, tolerance comparison, environment fingerprinting, CSV metadata export, and single-result auditing. Extend the audit system with batch mode and environment awareness:

**Batch Audit Mode**

- Add a batch mode
